mentions.name: codeinput.com
mentions.description: A tool to augment Git-related processes such as merge conflicts, ownership, and automation. It is built entirely on Cloudflare Workers using Rust/WASM, with the whole back-end running as a single WASM worker; it has been in development for close to 10 months and has not yet launched.
